decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sustained, coherent multi-axis descent from ~485 to 580 with possible inflection, and (2) an abrupt final drop across all axes at 725–729. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth motion without ambiguous superposed changes.

regions.observation: Clear multi-axis coherent downward trend beginning ~index 490, with N/E/U all descending together; E and U show a possible plateau or inflection near 560–580 before continuing down—suggests a sustained offset or slow slip rather than noise. Surroundings (485–580) show the onset and early evolution of this change.

Abrupt multi-sample drop in all axes around index 725–729 (last window), especially sharp in U and E; N also drops but less steeply. The drop appears non-recoverable within the window and coincides with the final data point—possible permanent jump or sensor issue. Includes enough context (725–729) to see the onset and full extent.
